name: io.github.NoBanks/shotcut-mcp
title: Shotcut MCP
description: Edit video through Shotcut's MLT engine: timelines, cuts, filters, titles, crossfades and renders.

environmentVariables.name: SHOTCUT_MCP_WORKDIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for .mlt projects and state files (default ~/shotcut-mcp-projects)

environmentVariables.name: MELT_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the MLT melt binary if it is not on PATH

environmentVariables.name: FFPROBE_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to ffprobe if it is not on PATH
